title: Thai Stir Fry with Sunday Beans
description: A classic Thai stir fry with Sunday beans, quick to make and packed with flavor.

ingredients.name: Stir fry
ingredients.notes: mix of your favorite vegetables (e.g., bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)

instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and stir-fry until the onion is translucent.
Add the Sunday beans, stir-fry mix, and soy sauce.
Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
